description: One whole paragraph inserted as paragraph 2 of a 3-paragraph document (revised document has 4 paragraphs).
base_paragraphs: This memorandum summarises the matters discussed at the partners meeting held on Monday morning.
The first item concerned the timetable for the annual audit and the appointment of the reporting accountants.
The meeting closed with an agreement to circulate the draft minutes before the end of the week.
revised_paragraphs: This memorandum summarises the matters discussed at the partners meeting held on Monday morning.
A further item concerned the renewal of the office lease and the costs of the proposed refurbishment.
